summary: Wah Fu Education Group Ltd. filed a Form 6-K reporting the immediate resignation of CEO/director Xinghui Yang on May 19, 2026. The board appointed Chairman Yang Yu as CEO effective same day and added Xiaoming Tang as a director. No price, premium, or consideration involved. This is a sudden, unscheduled departure creating an abrupt leadership change, distinct from routine meeting notices or proxy circulars. The filing does not disclose a reason for resignation or any severance terms. Watch for potential strategic shifts under new CEO Yu, who also serves as Chairman, and whether further board or management changes follow.
